#define WEBRTC_RECV_QUEUE_SIZE 512

Maximum receive queue size (messages buffered before recv()). Power of 2 for ringbuffer optimization. Completed ACIP packets are queued here. On overflow, retain control packets and recent media so the connection can recover.
